items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: it did give me a chance to work with Lanny Morgan and Willie Maiden, and of course with Slide.

ctx.x: He didn’t have a wonderful reputation about taking care of the people in the band.

No. That’s for sure. With Maynard [Ferguson], I was only there for a tour, for part of a tour with Maynard. That was because Slide [Hampton] got me on the band. Slide said, here’s an opening. I think Butter Burgess [Bob Burgess] had just left. I came on the band and did that tour with them. And it really wasn’t going to work out, because I was playing bass trombone. They only had two trombones, and it didn’t make any difference what I did – it [the sound] was going to be too heavy. So consequently, all I did was…
